_metadata.description: Disease-specific TNM staging nuances for guiding AI calculator generation
_metadata.purpose: Feed to Sonnet along with Opus example to achieve Opus-quality output at Sonnet cost

t_stage_nuances.T1: Subsite-specific: Glottic T1a (one cord) vs T1b (both cords). Supraglottic: limited to one subsite with normal cord mobility
t_stage_nuances.T2: Extension beyond subsite without fixation. Glottic: extension to supraglottis/subglottis OR impaired mobility
t_stage_nuances.T3: Vocal cord fixation OR paraglottic space invasion OR inner cortex thyroid cartilage erosion OR pre-epiglottic space
t_stage_nuances.T4a: Through thyroid cartilage (outer cortex), cricoid, hyoid, thyroid gland, esophagus, central compartment soft tissue
t_stage_nuances.T4b: Prevertebral space, carotid encasement, mediastinal structures - UNRESECTABLE

key_imaging_features: Assess vocal cord mobility on phonation if possible
Thyroid cartilage: distinguish inner cortex sclerosis (T3) from through-and-through (T4a)
critical_pitfalls: Confusing T1a vs T1b for glottic tumors
Overcalling cartilage invasion based on sclerosis alone
Not checking for subglottic extension (>10mm below glottis = subglottic primary)

special_considerations: HPV status changes staging completely - separate system

t_stage_nuances.T0: HPV+ with unknown primary but cervical node mets
t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤2cm
t_stage_nuances.T3: >4cm OR extension to lingual surface of epiglottis
t_stage_nuances.T4: Invasion of larynx, deep/extrinsic tongue muscles, pterygoid, hard palate, mandible

n_stage_nuances.note: HPV+ uses CLINICAL N staging based on number and size, NOT laterality

key_differences_from_hpv_negative: Cystic nodes are common and don't indicate worse prognosis

special_considerations: Use traditional H&N staging
ENE upstages N category

t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤2cm
t_stage_nuances.T3: >4cm OR extension to lingual surface of epiglottis
t_stage_nuances.T4a: Larynx, deep/extrinsic tongue muscles, medial pterygoid, hard palate, mandible
t_stage_nuances.T4b: Lateral pterygoid, pterygoid plates, lateral nasopharynx, skull base, carotid encasement

t_stage_nuances.T1: Confined to nasopharynx, OR extension to oropharynx/nasal cavity without parapharyngeal involvement
t_stage_nuances.T2: Parapharyngeal extension AND/OR adjacent soft tissue (medial pterygoid, lateral pterygoid, prevertebral muscles)
t_stage_nuances.T3: Skull base bony structures AND/OR paranasal sinuses
t_stage_nuances.T4: Intracranial extension, cranial nerve involvement, hypopharynx, orbit, extensive soft tissue beyond lateral pterygoid

key_imaging_features: Skull base erosion vs permeation (both count)
Cranial nerve enhancement (V, VI most common)
critical_pitfalls: Missing retropharyngeal node involvement (important for prognosis)
Subtle skull base permeation without gross erosion

t_stage_nuances.size_and_depth: BOTH size AND depth of invasion (DOI) matter
t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤2cm AND DOI ≤5mm
t_stage_nuances.T2: >2cm to ≤4cm AND DOI ≤10mm, OR ≤2cm with DOI >5mm to ≤10mm
t_stage_nuances.T3: >4cm OR DOI >10mm
t_stage_nuances.T4a: Through cortical bone (mandible/maxilla), maxillary sinus, skin of face
t_stage_nuances.T4b: Masticator space, pterygoid plates, skull base, internal carotid artery encasement

oral_cavity.depth_of_invasion_key: DOI is measured from basement membrane of closest normal mucosa, NOT from tumor surface

t_stage_nuances.T1: Limited to mucosa without bone erosion
t_stage_nuances.T2: Bone erosion/destruction including hard palate/middle meatus, EXCEPT posterior wall maxilla and pterygoid plates
t_stage_nuances.T3: Posterior wall maxillary sinus, subcutaneous tissues, floor/medial wall orbit, pterygoid fossa, ethmoid sinuses
t_stage_nuances.T4a: Anterior orbit, skin, pterygoid plates, cribriform plate, sphenoid/frontal sinuses, minimal dura
t_stage_nuances.T4b: Orbital apex, dura (extensive), brain, middle cranial fossa, CN (other than V2), nasopharynx, clivus

t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤2cm without extraparenchymal extension
t_stage_nuances.T3: >4cm AND/OR extraparenchymal extension
t_stage_nuances.T4a: Skin, mandible, ear canal, facial nerve
t_stage_nuances.T4b: Skull base, pterygoid plates, carotid encasement

special_considerations: Facial nerve involvement = T4a minimum
Histologic grade matters greatly for prognosis
Perineural invasion common in adenoid cystic

t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤2cm limited to thyroid. T1a ≤1cm, T1b >1-2cm
t_stage_nuances.T3b: Gross extrathyroidal extension into strap muscles only
t_stage_nuances.T4a: Gross extension to subcutaneous soft tissue, larynx, trachea, esophagus, RLN
t_stage_nuances.T4b: Prevertebral fascia, carotid artery, mediastinal vessels

age_based_staging.under_55: Stage I = any T, any N, M0; Stage II = any T, any N, M1

t_stage_nuances.size_critical: Measure solid component on CT for part-solid nodules
t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a ≤1cm, T1b >1-2cm, T1c >2-3cm. All: surrounded by lung/visceral pleura, not more proximal than lobar bronchus
t_stage_nuances.T2: T2a >3-4cm, T2b >4-5cm. OR involves main bronchus (not carina), OR visceral pleura, OR atelectasis to hilum
t_stage_nuances.T3: >5-7cm, OR chest wall/phrenic nerve/parietal pericardium, OR separate nodule same lobe
t_stage_nuances.T4: >7cm, OR diaphragm/mediastinum/heart/great vessels/trachea/carina/RLN/esophagus/spine, OR separate nodule different ipsilateral lobe

key_imaging_features: Measure solid component only for part-solid nodules
Short axis for lymph nodes (>1cm suspicious)
Chest wall invasion: rib destruction, soft tissue mass
Mediastinal invasion: >3cm contact, loss of fat plane, >90° aortic contact

t_stage_nuances.T1: Ipsilateral parietal pleura only (± visceral, ± mediastinal, ± diaphragmatic pleura)
t_stage_nuances.T2: Involves diaphragm muscle OR lung parenchyma
t_stage_nuances.T3: Locally advanced but potentially resectable: endothoracic fascia, mediastinal fat, single chest wall focus, pericardium (not transmural)
t_stage_nuances.T4: Unresectable: diffuse chest wall, transdiaphragmatic peritoneum, contralateral pleura, spine, internal surface pericardium, myocardium, brachial plexus, multifocal chest wall

t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a: encapsulated or unencapsulated with/without mediastinal fat extension, T1b: pericardium
t_stage_nuances.T3a: Brachiocephalic vein, SVC, chest wall, phrenic nerve, hilar vessels (extrapericardial)
t_stage_nuances.T3b: Aorta, aortic arch vessels, intrapericardial pulmonary artery, myocardium, trachea, esophagus

special_factors.grade: Nottingham grade 1-3 impacts prognosis more than T stage

t_stage_nuances.Tis: DCIS or Paget without invasive component
t_stage_nuances.T1: T1mi ≤1mm, T1a >1mm-5mm, T1b >5mm-10mm, T1c >10mm-20mm
t_stage_nuances.T3: >50mm
t_stage_nuances.T4: T4a: chest wall (not pectoral muscle alone), T4b: skin ulceration/satellite nodules/edema (including peau d'orange), T4c: both 4a+4b, T4d: inflammatory carcinoma

n_stage_nuances.N1: 1-3 axillary nodes (metastasis >2mm) OR internal mammary (sentinel node only, not clinically detected)
n_stage_nuances.N2: 4-9 axillary nodes OR clinically detected internal mammary without axillary
n_stage_nuances.N3: ≥10 axillary, OR infraclavicular, OR clinically detected internal mammary with axillary, OR supraclavicular

key_imaging_features: Measure invasive component only (not DCIS extent)
Multifocal: use largest focus for T, note multifocality
Skin thickening: distinguish reactive vs tumor involvement
Internal mammary nodes: significant if >5mm short axis
critical_pitfalls: Confusing reactive skin thickening with inflammatory carcinoma

t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a: lamina propria/muscularis mucosae, T1b: submucosa
t_stage_nuances.T3: Adventitia

t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a: lamina propria/muscularis mucosae, T1b: submucosa
t_stage_nuances.T3: Subserosal connective tissue (not visceral peritoneum or adjacent structures)
t_stage_nuances.T4: T4a: serosa (visceral peritoneum), T4b: adjacent structures

t_stage_nuances.T1: Submucosa
t_stage_nuances.T3: Through muscularis propria into pericolorectal tissues
t_stage_nuances.T4: T4a: visceral peritoneum, T4b: directly invades other organs/structures

n_stage_nuances.N1: N1a: 1 node, N1b: 2-3 nodes, N1c: tumor deposits without nodes

special_considerations: Tumor deposits (N1c) are discrete nodules in pericolorectal fat without residual lymph node tissue
CRM (circumferential resection margin) critical for rectum
EMVI (extramural vascular invasion) is prognostic

t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a: solitary ≤2cm, T1b: solitary >2cm without vascular invasion
t_stage_nuances.T2: Solitary with vascular invasion >2cm, OR multiple ≤5cm
t_stage_nuances.T3: Multiple, at least one >5cm
t_stage_nuances.T4: Single or multiple with major portal/hepatic vein involvement

special_considerations: Fibrosis/cirrhosis stage impacts prognosis independently
AFP level matters
Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer (BCLC) often used alongside TNM

t_stage_nuances.T3: >4cm
t_stage_nuances.T4: Involves celiac axis, SMA, and/or common hepatic artery

resectability_criteria.resectable: No arterial contact, ≤180° SMV/portal vein contact without contour irregularity
resectability_criteria.borderline: >180° SMV/portal vein contact or vein contour irregularity, gastroduodenal artery encasement up to hepatic artery, SMA contact ≤180°
resectability_criteria.unresectable: Solid tumor contact >180° SMA, celiac axis involvement, unreconstructable SMV/portal vein

t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a: ≤4cm, T1b: >4-7cm, confined to kidney
t_stage_nuances.T3: T3a: renal vein or segmental branches, perinephric/renal sinus fat (not beyond Gerota's fascia), T3b: IVC below diaphragm, T3c: IVC above diaphragm or IVC wall
t_stage_nuances.T4: Beyond Gerota's fascia including ipsilateral adrenal (contiguous)

special_considerations: Renal vein tumor thrombus level matters
IVC thrombus: measure level relative to hepatic veins and diaphragm
Adrenal involvement: contiguous = T4, discontinuous = M1

t_stage_nuances.T1: Lamina propria
t_stage_nuances.T2: T2a: inner half muscularis propria, T2b: outer half muscularis propria
t_stage_nuances.T3: T3a: microscopic perivesical fat, T3b: macroscopic perivesical fat
t_stage_nuances.T4: T4a: prostate stroma/seminal vesicles/uterus/vagina, T4b: pelvic wall/abdominal wall

key_imaging_features: Loss of muscle layer hypointensity on T2 MRI
Perivesical fat stranding vs nodular enhancement

prostate.clinical_vs_pathological: Imaging staging differs from surgical pathology staging

t_stage_nuances.T1: Clinically inapparent (not palpable, not visible on imaging): T1a <5% of TURP tissue, T1b ≥5% TURP tissue, T1c: needle biopsy (elevated PSA)
t_stage_nuances.T2: Confined to prostate: T2a ≤half one lobe, T2b >half one lobe, T2c: both lobes
t_stage_nuances.T3: Extraprostatic extension: T3a: extracapsular (unilateral or bilateral), T3b: seminal vesicle invasion
t_stage_nuances.T4: Bladder neck, external sphincter, rectum, levator muscles, pelvic wall

special_considerations: PSA level and Gleason score more important than T stage
MRI: look for capsular bulge, irregular margin, seminal vesicle invasion
PI-RADS scoring for lesion characterization

t_stage_nuances.pT1: Limited to testis (including rete testis) ± epididymis, no LVI: pT1a: <3cm, pT1b: ≥3cm
t_stage_nuances.pT2: Limited to testis with LVI, OR involvement of hilar soft tissue, OR penetration of mesothelial tunica vaginalis

testis.s_stage: Serum tumor markers (AFP, hCG, LDH) create unique S stage used with TNM

t_stage_nuances.T1a: Microscopic only: T1a1 ≤3mm depth, <7mm horizontal, T1a2 >3-5mm depth, <7mm horizontal
t_stage_nuances.T2: Beyond uterus but not pelvic wall/lower third vagina: T2a: no parametrial invasion (T2a1 ≤4cm, T2a2 >4cm), T2b: parametrial invasion
t_stage_nuances.T3: T3a: lower third vagina, T3b: pelvic wall and/or hydronephrosis

special_considerations: FIGO staging now incorporates imaging and nodes
Parametrial invasion: loss of periureteral hypointense rim on MRI
Hydroureter/hydronephrosis = T3b

t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a: one ovary, capsule intact, no surface tumor, negative washings; T1b: both ovaries (same criteria); T1c: with capsule rupture/surface tumor/positive cytology
t_stage_nuances.T2: Pelvic extension: T2a: uterus/fallopian tube; T2b: other pelvic tissue
t_stage_nuances.T3: T3a: microscopic peritoneal metastasis beyond pelvis (including liver capsule); T3b: macroscopic peritoneal metastasis ≤2cm; T3c: macroscopic peritoneal metastasis >2cm and/or regional nodes

t_stage_nuances.T1: T1a: <50% myometrial invasion, T1b: ≥50% myometrial invasion
t_stage_nuances.T2: Cervical stromal invasion (not just endocervical glandular involvement)
t_stage_nuances.T3: T3a: serosa and/or adnexa, T3b: vaginal and/or parametrial involvement

special_considerations: Grade (1-3) important for treatment decisions
Histologic type matters: endometrioid vs serous vs clear cell
LVSI (lymphovascular space invasion) is prognostic

t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤8cm greatest dimension
t_stage_nuances.T3: Discontinuous tumors in primary bone site (skip metastases)

special_considerations: Grade (low vs high) critical for staging
Spine tumors have separate staging
Pelvis tumors: assess sacral nerve involvement

soft_tissue_sarcoma.grade_critical: FNCLCC grade (1-3) determines stage grouping - grade 1 cannot be stage III even if T4

t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤1mm: T1a ≤0.8mm without ulceration, T1b ≤0.8mm with ulceration OR 0.8-1mm with/without ulceration
t_stage_nuances.T2: >1-2mm: T2a without ulceration, T2b with ulceration
t_stage_nuances.T3: >2-4mm: T3a without ulceration, T3b with ulceration
t_stage_nuances.T4: >4mm: T4a without ulceration, T4b with ulceration

n_stage_nuances.microsatellites_in_transit: N1c, N2c, N3c denote in-transit/satellite mets without nodes
n_stage_nuances.N3: ≥4 nodes or any matted nodes or ≥2 nodes + in-transit

t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤2cm
t_stage_nuances.T3: >5cm

site_specific_t_staging.stomach: T1 ≤1cm (T1a: mucosa, T1b: submucosa), T2 >1cm or muscularis, T3 subserosa, T4 serosa or adjacent
site_specific_t_staging.small_intestine: T1 mucosa/submucosa ≤1cm, T2 muscularis or >1cm, T3 subserosa, T4 peritoneum or adjacent
site_specific_t_staging.appendix: T1 ≤2cm and ≤3mm into subserosa, T2 ≤2cm and >3mm into subserosa or muscularis, T3 >2cm or >3mm into subserosa, T4 peritoneum/adjacent organs

t_stage_nuances.T1: ≤2cm, confined to pancreas
t_stage_nuances.T3: >4cm OR duodenum/bile duct invasion
t_stage_nuances.T4: Adjacent organs (stomach, spleen, colon, adrenal) OR large vessels (celiac axis, SMA)

ann_arbor_staging.II: Two or more lymph node regions, same side of diaphragm
ann_arbor_staging.III: Lymph nodes on both sides of diaphragm
ann_arbor_staging.IV: Extranodal disease beyond E designation (liver, bone marrow, lung nodules)

modifiers.A_B: A = no B symptoms, B = fever/night sweats/weight loss >10%
modifiers.E: Single extranodal site contiguous with nodal disease
modifiers.X: Bulky disease (varies by type: Hodgkin >10cm, NHL often >7cm)

brain.who_grading: WHO grade I-IV is used instead of TNM
